description: Master the building blocks: serving content, scaling the tiers, and the core patterns every large system is assembled from.

title: Async & Real-Time
description: Decouple with queues, push updates in real time, and tame the systems that must never sleep or drop a message.

title: Social, Media & Places
description: Photo feeds, timelines, file sync, calendars and location search — the classic product-design interview questions.

title: Data Infrastructure
description: Build the plumbing everyone else depends on: queues, logs, metrics, analytics and real-time ranking pipelines.

title: Everyday Products
description: Weather, parts pickers, wikis, marketplaces, photo libraries, logins and on-call tools — product questions where the data model and APIs matter as much as scale.

title: Live Counts & Presence
description: Counters, presence and live updates pushed to millions of screens at once.

title: Rides, Ranking & Experiments
description: Location indexes, ETAs, dynamic prices, experiments and ad auctions driven by streams and models.

title: Money & Flash Sales
description: Exactly-once inventory and payments: free-food vouchers, room bookings, card charges and wire transfers.

title: Batch & Coordination
description: Sort, rank, schedule and move data in bulk across fleets of machines.

title: Running Distributed Systems
description: Downloads, peer-to-peer transfer, health checks, tracing and the control plane that runs a database.
